claims.claim_vi: The Transformer (NIPS 2017) uses attention only, without recurrence or convolution, and is more parallelizable so it trains in less time.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: GANs were published at NIPS 2014: a generator and a discriminator trained against each other.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters and is applied via text prompts without gradient updates or fine-tuning (paper dated May 2020).
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: InstructGPT (arXiv 2203.02155, submitted 4 Mar 2022) fine-tunes with labeler demonstrations and rankings, then reinforcement learning from human feedback.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: ChatGPT was introduced as a free research preview trained with the same methods as InstructGPT, with slight differences in data collection; 30 Nov 2022 date.
claims.verified_by: Method and free preview from a search excerpt of the OpenAI post; the 30 Nov 2022 date from third-party coverage, not the OpenAI page.

claims.claim_vi: Rule-based systems (1950s), machine learning on small data (1980s) and CNN/RNN neural networks (1990-2010) are general trends, not tied to one work.
claims.verified_by: Carried from the source as context; labelled a trend in the lesson and not independently checked.

design_notes_vi: Dòng thời gian dọc tám mốc, mỗi mốc một thẻ; ghi chú nói các mốc đầu là xu hướng. Chỉ các mốc có bài báo hoặc thông báo mới có ngày cụ thể. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source places GANs in the 1990s-2000s; the GAN paper is from 2014, so the lesson uses 2014.
Source ends at '2018 - Now'; the lesson adds checkable milestones (GPT-3, InstructGPT, ChatGPT release) and drops unsourced commercial claims.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
